## Change and reason

Identify the affected section or XML anchor and any related issue.

For manuscript changes, identify the review candidate and the question on
which feedback is most useful. Link a rendered preview or the successful
`editor-site` CI artifact and a comparison with the base revision. A pinned
preview should name its commit so that later PR edits are not confused with it.

## Checks

Note the checks run (`make review`, `make check`, `make test`, `make build`, `make site`)
or any that could not be run. Do not edit the published snapshot.

See CONTRIBUTING.md for IETF contribution terms, attribution, and privacy.
